model: Originated fair lines v1 (research baseline, not a bet recommendation). Team strength = (PF - PA) / games played from official standings. Home field = +2.0 pts to the home team (assumption, flagged DG-A). Fair spread = points the home team lays (negative = home favored). Fair win probability = logistic(home expected margin / 13.5). Fair total = 2 x league-average points per team per game (v1 baseline; team-strength-adjusted totals are v2 and not yet published). Fair moneyline derived from fair win probability at the assumed -110 vig-free conversion. Every cell is a model output; none is an official price.
assumptions_flagged: DG-A home field +2.0 pts (no official source; sensitivity not yet tested)
DG-B logistic margin SD 13.5 pts (not calibrated to official closing prices — none exist)
DG-C fair total ignores team offensive/defensive splits (v1 limitation)
